text:
harry: quick flag 1: after the midnight SDK unpin, we're getting intermittent compatibility errors on ml-internal tenants (alpha group). I'm proposing a short-lived runtime pin for the alpha affinity to buy time for a small shim.

deploy-bot: scan-result: alpha-affinity (hosts: ml-internal-*) showing 4/12 bind-errors post-unpin. recommended mitigation: apply runtime-pin runtime@3.1.1-alpha-lock scoped to affinity=alpha.
rachel: can we target only the alpha affinity? some prod tenants are on the same hosts but tagged prod. we must avoid blast radius.
harry: yes. the plan is affinity-only. command we would run: `/deploy pin runtime --target ml-internal --affinity alpha --version runtime@3.1.1-alpha-lock --reason "post-unpin bind regressions"`. Change window 20m.

sre-bot: automation verified -> apply achievable. pre-check: ensure no active deploys in the next 15m.
oli: from runtime: the failure matches a binding table parity bug introduced in 3.1.2. backport branch ready (3.1.3-backport) but needs CI signoff. ETA ~3h.
qa-bot: quick smoke on affected subset before pin: model_bind: FAIL (4/12 hosts), api_surface: PASS, perf: PASS. after pin expected to stabilize. link: https://ci.redwood/internal/alpha/1266
harry: schedule: apply pin immediately, smoke run +10m, hold for 6h or until backport validated. rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for alpha. Runbook ref: /runbooks/affinity-runtime-pin.md
deploy-bot: queued action -> apply runtime-pin -> target=ml-internal, affinity=alpha, version=runtime@3.1.1-alpha-lock, requested_by=harry, runbook=/runbooks/affinity-runtime-pin.md

sre-bot: [running] apply in progress at 1717005660
deploy-bot: [completed] runtime pin applied id=pin-20240325-09 at 1717005685

oli: will post backport PR and image tag once CI green. tagging @rachel to help coordinate customer notifications for alpha list.
harry: thanks all. keep an eye on the dashboard. I'll unpin once 3.1.3-backport is validated or after 6h. If any anomalies, we roll back to runtime@3.1.1-alpha-lock across affinity and open incident.
